summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 solely to announce a monthly dividend of $0.225 per common share, payable October 28, 2026, to shareholders of record September 30, 2026. Shareholders may receive cash or shares via the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration by a business development company (BDC), not a special-situation event. No strategic transaction, board change, or unusual corporate action is disclosed. The filing contains no deal terms, advisors, or premium information. What to watch: none; this is a periodic distribution notice typical for BDCs.
